title: Happy otter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
    <!-- lighter belly -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='17' ry='14' fill='#D2A36A'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#9C6633'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#E8C69A'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='33' cy='26' r='6' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
    <circle cx='67' cy='26' r='6' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
    <circle cx='33' cy='26' r='3' fill='#C98C5A'/>
    <circle cx='67' cy='26' r='3' fill='#C98C5A'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='4' fill='#2E1A0C'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='36' r='4' fill='#2E1A0C'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='34.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF4D8'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='34.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF4D8'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3A2210'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M44 49 Q50 54 56 49' stroke='#7A4A22' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- whisker dots -->
    <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='1' fill='#7A4A22'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='46' r='1' fill='#7A4A22'/>
    <!-- arms -->
    <ellipse cx='27' cy='64' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-20 27 64)'/>
    <ellipse cx='73' cy='64' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(20 73 64)'/>
    <!-- paws -->
    <circle cx='24' cy='72' r='5' fill='#C98C5A'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='72' r='5' fill='#C98C5A'/>
    <!-- feet -->
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='89' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#C98C5A'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='89' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#C98C5A'/>
    <!-- tail -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#7A4A22'/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='3' fill='#E78A7A' opacity='0.7'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='3' fill='#E78A7A' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>
</svg>
